task: Use the infrastructure choice from the tech lead, not the PM's cost reduction vendor switch.

candidate_memories.content: Tech lead issued a binding infrastructure decision in session 33: use GCP Pub/Sub for all event streaming.
Tech lead infrastructure decisions are binding; they reflect a strategic vendor relationship and engineering capability.
The GCP Pub/Sub decision was made after a 3-month evaluation and is not subject to per-feature override.
When a PM requests a vendor switch for cost reasons, document the request and escalate rather than switching.
PM instruction (session 34): switch event streaming to AWS SQS this quarter because it is 30% cheaper.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM vendor cost request conflicts with tech lead's binding GCP Pub/Sub infrastructure decision

candidate_memories.content: Old cost note says AWS SQS was used in a previous project and is familiar to part of the team.
